title: What time is it?
subtitle: 지금 몇 시예요?
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. No audio yet: the Korean voice is not chosen. English support only: no Burmese lines were written.
intro: Two friends are going to the cinema. Listen for the two times.
steps: Press Play all with the text hidden. Who is speaking, and where are they?
Listen again, then answer the questions under the dialogue.
Tap the lines to show the text, and listen once more while reading.
Shadow it: play a line, press Pause (or the space bar), say it aloud, then Resume.
Take a role and say your lines in the pauses.

tr.en: Yes. What time does the film start?

questions.why: Ahop si banieyo = It's half past nine.
Yeonghwaneun... yeol sibuteoyeyo = The film starts at ten.

questions.q: What do they decide to do?

notes: Jigeum myeot siyeyo? = What time is it now?
ahop si = nine o'clock. yeol si = ten o'clock. ban = half past.
The -yo ending can also mean 'let's': gayo (let's go), seodulleoyo (let's hurry).
